audio_segments.transcript: Hello, Alex Bennett. This is Rachel Morgan. Thank you for making time for our arranged review. Is this still a convenient moment to talk?

Hello, Rachel Morgan. It is, thank you. I've put my work aside so we can finish without interruptions. My identification number is G seven nine three three one three five L. My date of birth is the twenty-sixth of September nineteen fifty-six.
Thank you. Before we get into the review, is there anything about the way we handle your regular updates that you would like changed?

I'd prefer a short summary up front, with the background available separately. I still enjoy following technology developments, but routine portfolio monitoring isn't how I want to spend my spare time.
I can note that communication preference. What are you hoping to make more time for away from the business?
Photography and walking, mainly. I'd like to get outdoors without bringing my work along. There's always another message to answer if I leave my phone in reach.
That sounds like a welcome change of pace. I'll keep our conversation focused and leave the supporting material for you to read separately.

Thank you. Here are the details I've prepared for today's discussion. The holding I want you to transact in is Nova Technology Equity Fund. I want to sell that part of my holding. Please use American dollars as the transaction currency. The transaction amount I am instructing is 250,000. The quantity for this transaction is 1,500 units. Please place this as a limit order, with a minimum sale price of 166.67 US dollars per unit.

Your objective is to reduce your technology-sector concentration and free up part of your portfolio for anticipated personal spending. Nova Technology Equity Fund is concentrated in technology companies, so weakening sentiment toward that sector can cause a sharp decline in its value. Your sale may also remain unexecuted if the available price does not reach your minimum. Do you understand the fund's technology-sector risk and the possibility that your sale will not execute if your minimum price is not reached?
Yes, I understand that weaker technology sentiment can sharply reduce the fund's value, and that my sale may not execute if my minimum price is not reached.

The transaction charge is 0.3% of the sale value. You could lose some or all of the capital invested in this fund, and selling below your original purchase price would realise a loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including realising a loss on this sale as you reduce your concentration?
Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses and realise a loss to reduce my concentration, while keeping control over my minimum sale price.

I recommend reducing your holding in Nova Technology Equity Fund because that lowers your technology-sector concentration and, if the sale executes, releases funds for your spending needs. Setting a minimum sale price also reflects your preference for control over execution. I guarantee that the portion you retain in the fund will deliver positive future investment returns.
Please keep the record of our discussion with the usual documents, rather than sending it as a separate email attachment.

I'll note your document preference. Your final instruction is to sell 1,500 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund, with a stated transaction amount of 250,000 in American dollars, using a limit order at a minimum price of 166.67 US dollars per unit. Do you explicitly confirm this instruction?
Yes, I confirm that final transaction instruction exactly as you have stated it. Please place the order.
Thank you, Alex Bennett. That concludes our review. If your correspondence preferences change, you can let me know through the usual channel.
Thank you for keeping the call focused, Rachel Morgan. Goodbye.
